findings.note: Glossary drift: this namespace calls a hub link 关联 everywhere (ui.hub.links.title "中心关联"; skills.detached "已关联"; subscriptions.policy_menu "关联策略"; links.links_count "个关联" - 17 occurrences), while 链接 appears only in this key and unpull_failed, so the body names a different thing (a hyperlink) than the link the subscription attaches to.
